adapter.name: qa-framework
adapter.description: rules in 01-business-rules.md, cases in 05-test-scenarios.md, linked by co-occurrence

dimensions.name: Oracle
dimensions.ceilingReason: reachable only where a rule inventory exists in the repository
dimensions.question: Read a sample of tests against the rules they cite. Do the expected values encode the rule, or does the test merely carry the rule id while asserting whatever the system returns?

dimensions.name: Sensitivity
dimensions.ceilingReason: level 3 needs measured sensitivity: mutation config in the repository (capped at 2 without it) or a rule broken on purpose, which v1 cannot read

constraints.rule: level 0 applies when tests that cannot fail are a CHARACTERISTIC of the suite, not an isolated defect
constraints.effect: capped at 0 - tests that cannot fail are a characteristic of this suite

constraints.rule: with no mutation testing configuration in the repository (D2.mutation-config empty), the dimension cannot exceed level 2; a config lifts the cap but never sets a floor
constraints.observed: no mutation testing configuration found in the repository
constraints.effect: capped at 2 - level 3 needs measured sensitivity; a rule broken on purpose leaves no trace v1 reads

dimensions.name: Determinism
dimensions.ceilingReason: level 3 asserts behavior across runs, which the repository cannot witness
dimensions.question: Read the fixed waits and the retries setting in context. Are they load tolerance decisions the config explains, or flake suppression?

dimensions.name: Diagnosis
dimensions.question: Read the test titles. Does a failure report name the business behavior that broke, or only the mechanism that was clicked?

dimensions.name: Rule coverage
dimensions.ceilingReason: level 3 needs the deliberate exclusions written down; v1 extracts no such statement
dimensions.question: Read the uncovered rules. Are they absent by decision or by oversight, and does anything in the repository say which?

dimensions.name: Life in CI
dimensions.ceilingReason: levels 2 and 3 assert merge and deploy gating, which lives in the CI server policy

constraints.rule: level 1 requires a pipeline that both invokes the runner and points at the resolved suite; otherwise level 0
constraints.observed: 0 pipeline(s) both invoke the runner and point at the suite

dimensions.name: Maintainability
dimensions.ceilingReason: level 3 needs review and retirement process evidence; v1 does not read history
dimensions.question: Read the test names and the largest files. Do names describe behavior or implementation, and is duplication structural or incidental?

teamQuestions.question: Is the failure rate of these tests across runs measured anywhere, and where can it be read?
teamQuestions.reason: level 3 asserts behavior across runs, which the repository cannot witness

teamQuestions.question: Are any business rules left out of the suite on purpose, and where is that decision written down?
teamQuestions.reason: level 3 needs the deliberate exclusions written down; v1 extracts no such statement

teamQuestions.question: Does this suite run from a pipeline defined outside this repository (another repository, a scheduled job or a release definition), and where is it defined?
teamQuestions.reason: levels 2 and 3 assert merge and deploy gating, which lives in the CI server policy

teamQuestions.question: Is there a process for reviewing and retiring tests, and where is it written down?
teamQuestions.reason: level 3 needs review and retirement process evidence; v1 does not read history

D5.negative-tests.vocabulary: NEGATIVE_VOCABULARY in src/extract-source.js (documented in docs/EVIDENCE-CATALOGUE.md, D5.negative-tests)

D0.suite-type-signals.note: signals only: the suite type is declared by the verdict, never computed here; every count is a number of tests
D0.suite-type-signals.vocabulary: DEFECT_ID in src/suite-type.js (documented in docs/EVIDENCE-CATALOGUE.md, D0.suite-type-signals)

D5.orphan-tests.note: automated cases whose id is declared in no scenario document

D5.pending-markers.note: markers for information the analysis could not confirm

D6.suite-invocation.note: a pipeline counts only when it invokes the runner (directly, or through an npm/yarn/pnpm script that expands to playwright test; an unresolvable npm test still counts) AND names a resolved suite directory

D6.run-scope.note: scope is read from the pipeline text; a filter marked variable is set outside the repository and its effective scope is unknowable here

D6.declared-gating.note: a pull request trigger is an intention; enforcement lives in the branch policy and is out of scope for v1
